patch_requests.patch:
Policy decision required; this is the proposed exact change. The encounter_research gate (lines ~291-295) can never pass under the repository's fail-closed research invariant (all contracts fidelity_blocked, enforced by tests/test_cata_raid_research_contracts.py and cata_raid_acceptance_policy_v1 research_rule). Either (a) keep research reported but not acceptance-blocking for the scoreboard finish line, replacing
    if fidelity_state != 'accepted':
        inputs.append(missing('encounter_research', f'research contract fidelity_state={fidelity_state}; follow '
                              'raid-encounter-research (WCL references, unresolved claims)', 'raid-encounter-research',
                              BLOCKS_ACCEPTANCE, path=(strategy or {}).get('contract')))
with
    if fidelity_state != 'accepted':
        inputs.append(missing('encounter_research', f'research contract fidelity_state={fidelity_state}; follow '
                              'raid-encounter-research (WCL references, unresolved claims)', 'raid-encounter-research',
                              'fidelity', path=(strategy or {}).get('contract')))
(and teach consumers that blocks='fidelity' is reported, not gating), or (b) keep it gating, and accept that no BWD unit can be accepted until the research invariant and tests are changed to allow a per-mode accepted state. Magmaw 10N research cannot honestly be marked accepted under either option today.

Archive the raw WCL captures the ledger cites from ~/.cache/magmaw_wcl into a DVC-tracked tarball, e.g. `tar czf artifacts/cata_raid_program/magmaw_wcl_20260927.tar.gz -C ~/.cache/magmaw_wcl MxFq7TRbvnjGY1hJ-f22.json Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy-f22.json Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy-f22-evidence.json Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy-f22-attacker-debuffs.json && dvc add artifacts/cata_raid_program/magmaw_wcl_20260927.tar.gz && dvc push`. Expected sha256: MxFq7TRbvnjGY1hJ-f22.json a971c77485a4670c2082373bf55c22d96f41bddc2b6d505b39a45e319b24c343; Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy-f22.json f359bce89e12c51c118797617ec83448584d37c986ea1a8c1b1d27be1aeb3611; Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy-f22-evidence.json 74d1c077ea1e8871a2e2f7c79a1f8d3c43a360aac7b6bd45682d4fb867f11703; Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy-f22-attacker-debuffs.json 869a34700758db5e3b4dd9cdcb6a0f53a1e15579f06325c4e7f392d0fb3e9d7e. Then set the two source_catalog entries' capture.raw_location (ids wcl_MxFq7TRbvnjGY1hJ_22_20260927, wcl_Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy_22_20260927) in magmaw_ledger_v1.json to that .dvc pointer and delete the local copies.
